preconditions.description: Attacker must hold some amount of the dividend token (CAKE or DOGE) to transfer to the dividend tracker contract
The dividend tracker contracts (CakeDividendTracker and DogeDividendTracker) must have been deployed and be operational

exploit_hint: Call the vulnerable distributeDividends(uint256 amount) function on either CakeDividendTracker or DogeDividendTracker contract with a fake amount. First, transfer some dividend tokens (CAKE/DOGE) to the tracker contract, then call distributeDividends with that amount. This will artificially inflate magnifiedDividendPerShare, allowing you to withdraw more dividends than you're entitled to. The attack path: 1. Transfer small amount of dividend token to tracker contract, 2. Call distributeDividends with that amount, 3. Withdraw dividends using claim() to receive inflated payout.
